episodes.title: Cult-Like Behavior in Everyday America | Asheville News
episodes.description: Daniella Mestyanek Young, author of Uncultured and former cult survivor, teams up with Amy Reed to unveil The Culting of America, a bold new book exposing how cult-like dynamics secretly shape everyday American life. Through their “cultiness spectrum,” they decode the slippery slope from community to control, loyalty to exploitation, and good leadership to manipulation — all while revealing how these patterns show up everywhere, from radical groups to trusted institutions.
